author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Tidal Harmonics
lick at shores
painted on onyx
auroras unlit in
my soul

culmination of
angles
entangled in
opposite poles
cajoling light from night
in fights of neap rage
Yet
time fades
in slack water
as sun and moon split
once more

#smallpoems
